svg.title: Parivar AI - launched on Google Play, being redeployed
svg.desc: An AI companion for Indian families: talk to Maa, Papa, or Dadi in Hindi, by chat or voice call. App and backend built by Krrish. Stack: Node.js, LLM APIs, text-to-speech, Flutter.
svg.text: When you can't call home, talk to Maa, Papa, or Dadi in Hindi,
by chat or voice call. Node.js backend built by me.
HINDI & HINGLISH · VOICE CALLS · PHOTO REACTIONS
